set.ref.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: an epic cinematic graphic-novel illustration in full color, bold black ink outlines and confident brush inking, dramatic cel shading with deep shadows, crimson red light against black with small gold accents.
<Subject 2> is the old master: an imposing old man with dark brown skin, a full white beard and very long grey-and-silver dreadlocks bound with small gold rings, a tiny gold crown on top of his head, wearing a fitted crimson red jumpsuit with a gold crown emblem on the chest and red armored gloves. He is powerful and full of swagger, and his moves hit hard on the beat.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a tight low view of the master's red gloved hands on the keys of a keyboard and the faders of a large mixing console, the tips of his white beard and grey dreadlocks at the top left, a speaker cabinet and the bottom of a red glowing monitor at the top right.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing a medium wide low three-quarter view of the master leaning over his studio desk with a focused glare, his gloved hands on the keys and faders, reel-to-reel tape machines and stacked speakers on the left, a hanging studio microphone above, the large monitor on the right glowing red with a pixelated portrait, smoke in the red light.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] A 5.2-second 16:9 single continuous shot in <Subject 1> that begins on <Picture 1> and ends on <Picture 2>: the master slams a fader up and the bass drops, the whole studio shakes with it, and the camera cranes up and back fast to reveal him throwing his head back with a fierce grin before he locks back in over the console.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (applies to [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the bold ink outlines and cel-shaded graphic-novel look; nothing becomes photographic, 3D or smooth.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, white beard, grey dreadlocks with gold rings, tiny crown and crimson jumpsuit.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - its composition.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 1] last frame): fully_preserved - its composition.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living graphic-novel illustration in <Subject 1> with real energy: ink lines stay crisp, hair and smoke keep their brushed texture, and motion is punchy and weighty, like a great music video.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, tight and low on his red gloved hands. His left hand hammers a hard chord on the keys and his right hand slams a fader all the way up. On that hit the bass drops: the speaker cone punches outward, a ring of smoke blasts out of the speaker, the red lights flare brighter, the monitor glitches with bright scan lines and dust shakes off the console. The camera answers with one fast, smooth crane move up and back, rising past his chest and beard to his face, as he throws his head back with a fierce open-mouthed grin, his long grey dreadlocks swinging out and the gold rings flashing in the red light. Then he drops his chin, nods hard to the beat and locks back into a focused glare over the console, his hands back on the keys and faders. The camera is still drifting up and back as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
A hard chord struck on the keys and the clack of a fader slammed home, then a huge deep bass drop that shakes the room, speaker cones thumping, a hiss of smoke, the old man's low laugh under the rumble.
